format: CSV with one row per attempted live or replay trial
cell_design: Sealed replay crosses all 4 bound predecessors, 4 actual predecessors, and 4 targets (64 cells). Live control crosses 4 actual predecessors and 4 targets with bound predecessor equal to actual predecessor (16 cells).
block_design: Every acquisition block contains all 80 legal cells exactly once; positions rotate uniformly over 80 blocks.
saturated_minimality: Arbitrary predecessor dependence requires four actual-predecessor means in each of 16 replay bound-target strata (64), while live control requires one mean in each of 16 actual-target strata; the disjoint record types give a lower bound of 80 cells, attained here.
retention_rule: Every attempt and reset failure is retained; live adaptation cannot rewrite a sealed replay transcript.
claim_boundary: Passing records reject predecessor-conditioned adaptation within the declared controller input manifest; undeclared physical side channels remain an apparatus-security question.
